<div class="ls53-widget">

    <defs>
      <!-- Acabado satinado de las poleas. -->
      <linearGradient
        id="ls53-roller-metal"
        x1="15%" y1="0%"
        x2="85%" y2="100%"
      >
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#EFF0F2"/>
        <stop offset="24%" stop-color="#E2E3E6"/>
        <stop offset="43%" class="ls53-metal-stop"/>
        <stop offset="56%" stop-color="#E7E8EA"/>
        <stop offset="74%" class="ls53-metal-stop"/>
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#C3C5CA"/>
      </linearGradient>

      <!-- Acabado metálico de las cubas. -->
      <linearGradient
        id="ls53-tank-metal"
        x1="0%" y1="0%"
        x2="0%" y2="100%"
      >
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ECEEF0"/>
        <stop offset="16%" stop-color="#E2E4E7"/>
        <stop offset="46%" class="ls53-metal-stop"/>
        <stop offset="62%" stop-color="#E2E3E6"/>
        <stop offset="84%" class="ls53-metal-stop"/>
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#C6C8CD"/>
      </linearGradient>

      <!-- Franja azul inferior. -->
      <linearGradient
        id="ls53-liquid-gradient"
        x1="0%" y1="0%"
        x2="0%" y2="100%"
      >
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#B4DCEF"/>
        <stop offset="35%" class="ls53-liquid-stop"/>
        <stop offset="75%" class="ls53-liquid-stop"/>
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#92C3DE"/>
      </linearGradient>

      <!-- Acabado del conjunto vertical derecho. -->
      <linearGradient
        id="ls53-hardware-metal"
        x1="0%" y1="0%"
        x2="100%" y2="0%"
      >
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#BCC0C6"/>
        <stop offset="22%" class="ls53-metal-stop"/>
        <stop offset="45%" stop-color="#ECEEF0"/>
        <stop offset="65%" stop-color="#E0E2E5"/>
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#BFC3C9"/>
      </linearGradient>

      <!-- Sombra ambiental y de contacto. -->
      <filter
        id="ls53-roller-shadow"
        x="-30%" y="-30%"
        width="160%" height="175%"
        color-interpolation-filters="sRGB"
      >
        <feGaussianBlur
          in="SourceAlpha"
          stdDeviation="1.5"
          result="rollerAmbientBlur"
        />
        <feOffset
          in="rollerAmbientBlur"
          dx="0.3" dy="2"
          result="rollerAmbientOffset"
        />
        <feFlood
          flood-color="#18212D"
          flood-opacity="0.12"
          result="rollerAmbientColor"
        />
        <feComposite
          in="rollerAmbientColor"
          in2="rollerAmbientOffset"
          operator="in"
          result="rollerAmbientShadow"
        />

        <feGaussianBlur
          in="SourceAlpha"
          stdDeviation="0.4"
          result="rollerContactBlur"
        />
        <feOffset
          in="rollerContactBlur"
          dx="0" dy="0.65"
          result="rollerContactOffset"
        />
        <feFlood
          flood-color="#111820"
          flood-opacity="0.17"
          result="rollerContactColor"
        />
        <feComposite
          in="rollerContactColor"
          in2="rollerContactOffset"
          operator="in"
          result="rollerContactShadow"
        />

        <feMerge>
          <feMergeNode in="rollerAmbientShadow"/>
          <feMergeNode in="rollerContactShadow"/>
          <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
        </feMerge>
      </filter>

      <!-- Sombra suave de las cubas. -->
      <filter
        id="ls53-tank-shadow"
        x="-5%" y="-30%"
        width="110%" height="175%"
        color-interpolation-filters="sRGB"
      >
        <feGaussianBlur
          in="SourceAlpha"
          stdDeviation="2"
          result="tankAmbientBlur"
        />
        <feOffset
          in="tankAmbientBlur"
          dx="0" dy="2.5"
          result="tankAmbientOffset"
        />
        <feFlood
          flood-color="#18212D"
          flood-opacity="0.10"
          result="tankAmbientColor"
        />
        <feComposite
          in="tankAmbientColor"
          in2="tankAmbientOffset"
          operator="in"
          result="tankAmbientShadow"
        />

        <feGaussianBlur
          in="SourceAlpha"
          stdDeviation="0.5"
          result="tankContactBlur"
        />
        <feOffset
          in="tankContactBlur"
          dx="0" dy="0.8"
          result="tankContactOffset"
        />
        <feFlood
          flood-color="#111820"
          flood-opacity="0.15"
          result="tankContactColor"
        />
        <feComposite
          in="tankContactColor"
          in2="tankContactOffset"
          operator="in"
          result="tankContactShadow"
        />

        <feMerge>
          <feMergeNode in="tankAmbientShadow"/>
          <feMergeNode in="tankContactShadow"/>
          <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
        </feMerge>
      </filter>

      <!-- Válvula para tubería vertical. -->
